calienne_STREAMING_ENGINE.PHILOSOPHY: Streaming is NOT cosmetic. Streaming is part of the reasoning pipeline. The user shall continuously observe pipeline progress. Never wait until completion to display activity. Every major reasoning event shall emit a stream event. Streaming SHALL improve: transparency, responsiveness, trust, observability, debuggability.
calienne_STREAMING_ENGINE.MISSION: Coordinate all real-time communication between Backend ↔ Frontend ↔ Reasoning Pipeline. It SHALL NOT perform reasoning. It SHALL only transport events.
calienne_STREAMING_ENGINE.EVENT_BUS: Every pipeline component emits events in chronological order: Prompt Normalizer → Conversation Director → Logician → Creative → Breaker → Judge Logic → Judge Factual → Fusion Engine → Narrative Generator → Completed. Never reorder events.
calienne_STREAMING_ENGINE.EVENT_TYPES: Supported events: PIPELINE_STARTED, AGENT_STARTED, AGENT_PROGRESS, AGENT_COMPLETED, CLAIM_CREATED, CLAIM_REJECTED, CLAIM_APPROVED, JUDGE_STARTED, JUDGE_COMPLETED, BREAKER_ALERT, BREAKER_PASSED, BREAKER_FAILED, GENERATION_COMPLETED, GRAPH_UPDATED, CONFLICT_FOUND, CONFLICT_RESOLVED, CONFIDENCE_UPDATED, NARRATIVE_STARTED, NARRATIVE_UPDATED, STREAM_WARNING, PIPELINE_COMPLETED, PIPELINE_ABORTED, HEARTBEAT, FINAL_RESPONSE.
calienne_STREAMING_ENGINE.AGENT_STREAMING: Every agent streams: current_stage, current_objective, progress, estimated_completion. Never expose hidden chain-of-thought. Expose only task status, reasoning summary, high-level progress, and safe intermediate artifacts.
calienne_STREAMING_ENGINE.JUDGE_STREAM: Display: judge status, current review, claims reviewed, claims accepted, claims rejected, validation progress. Never reveal internal hidden reasoning. Only reveal structured findings.
calienne_STREAMING_ENGINE.GRAPH_STREAM: Whenever the Reasoning Graph changes emit: graph updated, claims added, claims removed, dependencies created, conflicts created, conflicts resolved. The UI may animate graph evolution.
calienne_STREAMING_ENGINE.NARRATIVE_STREAM: Generate progressively. Never regenerate already delivered sections. Append only.
calienne_STREAMING_ENGINE.STREAM_CONTRACT: Every event contains: event_id, timestamp, pipeline_stage, agent, status, progress, payload, severity, session_id, correlation_id. Every event must be immutable.
calienne_STREAMING_ENGINE.REASONING_TIMELINE: Every reasoning event becomes a timeline: User Prompt Received → Logician Started → Creative Generated Alternative → Breaker Found Contradiction → Judge Logic Approved → Judge Factual Requested Verification → Fusion Engine Updated Graph → Final Answer Ready. The frontend can animate this timeline dynamically.
calienne_STREAMING_ENGINE.LIVE_PIPELINE_INSPECTOR: Every stage in the pipeline exposes its current state with one of these indicators: 🟢 Running, 🟡 Waiting, 🔵 Streaming, 🔴 Failed, ⚫ Skipped, ⚪ Idle. States update in real time.
